Prerequisite: Must have Round of Applause

Boogie Woogie, as effective as it is in solo combat, only reaches its full potential not with an ally, but with a best friend. At the start of combat, you can choose one ally as a Best Friend. When fighting with that ally, you gain the following benefits:

  • When you switch the place of your Best Friend with an ally who was previously in melee range of an enemy, on top of advantage, the attack will have its critical range increased by 3.

  • Swapping your Best Friend has no cost.

  • When flanking with your Best Friend, you and your Best Friend gain a bonus to damage rolls equal to your proficiency bonus.
